jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The School of Journalism and Communication is dedicated to educating communication experts adept at information technology and capable of generating high-quality communication content, products and services. The School is also dedicated to research into various important aspects of communication. This programme places equal emphasis on theoretical and professional ethics. It offers three main streams of study: Journalism, Advertising and Public Relations, and Creative and New Media. Based on their particular interests, students can specialise in one or two professional streams, or select courses from different streams. The School is committed to providing an environment with up-to-date technology that will facilitate teaching and learning, as well as the production of creative media. Our professional facilities include 4K-UHD Virtual Set Studio, Digital Radio Studio, Black Box Studio, Creative Hubs, VO Lab and VR Lab. The programme offers four practicum groups to students: U-Beat, Varsity, Pinpoint, and Creative Media Laboratory . Students can choose to participate in the writing, editing and production of one of the School’s two news practicum magazines: U-Beat , which is published in Chinese, or Varsity , published in English. Students can also acquire hands-on experience conducting social and commercial campaigns by working at Pinpoint . Those who join the Creative Media Laboratory gain knowledge and skills in audio and visual media production. In addition, the programme arranges summer internship placements for all students.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Explore the media world with our Journalism and Communication Programme The programme aims to educate students to become communication professionals with a global perspective, who are rich in transferable skills and have analytical and innovative minds to express ideas though media and generate high-quality communication content. We seek to instil a strong sense of social consciousness and commitment to professional ethics, freedom of expression and social responsibility. Upholding our motto “inherit, inspire and innovate”, the programme invites students to dive into the media world and equips them with solid knowledge that inspires new perspectives. The programme offers three main professional tracks: (1) Journalism, (2) Advertising and Public Relations, and (3) Creative and New Media. Based on their particular interests, students can specialise in one or two professional tracks, or select courses from different tracks. The programme offers four practicum groups for students:  U-Beat, Varsity, Pinpoint,  and  Creative Media Laboratory . Students can choose to participate in the writing, editing and production of one of the School’s two news practicum magazines:  U-Beat , which is published in Chinese, or  Varsity , which is published in English. Students can also acquire hands-on experience conducting social and commercial campaigns by working at  Pinpoint . Those who join the  Creative Media Laboratory  gain knowledge and skills in audio and visual media production. In addition, the programme arranges summer internship placements for all students.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JUPAS Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target Score Strategy**
Aim for at least 28.95 (median) in Best 5; 27.8 (LQ) is the minimum competitive threshold. With Chinese weighted x1.3, a high Chinese grade (5** or 5*) significantly boosts your score.
- Use the median subject profile as a benchmark: Chinese 5**, English 3, Math 3, two electives at 5.
**2. Band A Placement**
Band A is critical: in 2025, all 40 offers went to Band A applicants. Place JS4850 in your top 3 choices to maximise chances.
- Band B/C/D/E received zero offers.
**3. Subject Selection**
Choose electives that align with communication studies (e.g., Liberal Studies, Economics, History, Literature). Any 2 electives at Level 3 or above are accepted.
- Applied Learning subjects with 'Attained with Distinction I/II' can be used as an extra elective for bonus points.
**4. Chinese Language Advantage**
Chinese is weighted 1.3x. A high grade (5** or 5*) can compensate for lower English or Math scores. Prioritise Chinese preparation.
- Median admit had Chinese 5**; LQ had 5*.
**5. English and Math Baseline**
English and Math minimums are Level 3 and Level 2 respectively. While median admits had English 3 and Math 3, a higher English grade (e.g., 5** in UQ profile) can improve your score.
- UQ profile shows English 5**, Math 4.
**6. No Interview, Focus on Scores**
Since there is no interview, your DSE results and subject weighting are the sole determinants. No need to prepare for interview questions.
- Allocate time to maximise DSE scores.
**7. Practicum and Portfolio**
While not required for admission, mention in your personal statement (if applicable) any media-related extracurriculars (school newspaper, video production) to demonstrate interest.
- The programme values hands-on experience; U-Beat, Varsity, Pinpoint, and Creative Media Lab are key selling points.
**8. Understand the Curriculum**
Familiarise yourself with the three tracks (Journalism, Advertising & PR, Creative & New Media) and four practicum groups. This shows genuine interest in the programme.
- Use the programme website (com.cuhk.edu.hk) for detailed course lists.
**9. Backup Plan**
Given the competitive Band A offer rate (~30.3%), have a backup choice in Band A or B that aligns with your interests (e.g., other social science programmes at CUHK).
- Consider JS4850 as a flagship choice; ensure your other choices are realistic based on your predicted scores.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 課程提供三個專業範疇：新聞、廣告與公關、創意與新媒體。
學生可專攻一至兩個範疇，或跨範疇選修。

為所有學生安排暑期實習。
著重理論與專業倫理並重。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生深受媒體、廣告、公關、政府、非政府組織、教育及商業機構歡迎。
約 60% 投身媒體行業，擔任記者、廣告/公關從業員或影片製作人。
約 30% 加入商業領域，從事管理、行政、銀行、會計及資訊科技工作。
另外 10% 加入政府、非政府組織或公共/社會企業。
部分畢業生繼續進修傳播學、文化研究、法律或社會工作。
僱主包括彭博、寶潔、Saatchi & Saatchi、Edelman、奧美、嗶哩嗶哩、滙豐、港鐵、ViuTV、南華早報、商業電台、明報、立法會及平等機會委員會。

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學沙田校園提供充滿活力的學習環境，設有九所書院，提供關顧及課外活動。
學生可使用先進媒體設施，包括 4K-UHD 虛擬錄影廠及數碼電台錄音室。
課程安排暑期實習，學生亦可透過大學全球網絡參與交流計劃。
書院生活包括文化活動、體育及領袖訓練。

tips.title: Ace Sir 的 JUPAS 策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 目標分數策略**
最佳 5 科目標至少 28.95（中位數）；27.8（下四分位數）為最低競爭門檻。中文加權 1.3 倍，高分中文（5** 或 5*）可大幅提升分數。
- 以中位數科目成績為基準：中文 5**、英文 3、數學 3、兩科選修 5。
**2. Band A 選擇**
Band A 至關重要：2025 年所有 40 個錄取名額均來自 Band A 申請人。將 JS4850 放在首三志願以最大化機會。
- Band B/C/D/E 均無錄取。
**3. 選科策略**
選擇與傳播學相關的選修科（如經濟、歷史、文學）。任何兩科選修達第 3 級或以上即可。
- 應用學習科目「達標並表現優異 I/II」可作為額外選修科獲加分。
**4. 中文科優勢**
中文加權 1.3 倍。高分中文（5** 或 5*）可彌補英文或數學較低分數。優先準備中文科。
- 中位數錄取者中文 5**；下四分位數 5*。
**5. 英文及數學基本要求**
英文最低第 3 級，數學第 2 級。中位數錄取者英文 3、數學 3，但更高英文分數（如上四分位數 5**）可提升總分。
- 上四分位數：英文 5**、數學 4。
**6. 無面試，專注分數**
無需面試，文憑試成績及科目比重為唯一決定因素。無需準備面試。
- 將時間用於提升文憑試分數。
**7. 實習及作品集**
雖然入學不要求，但可在個人陳述中提及媒體相關課外活動（如校報、影片製作）以展示興趣。
- 課程重視實踐經驗；U-Beat、Varsity、Pinpoint 及 Creative Media Lab 為重點。
**8. 了解課程內容**
熟悉三個範疇（新聞、廣告與公關、創意與新媒體）及四個實習小組，展現對課程的 genuine 興趣。
- 瀏覽課程網站（com.cuhk.edu.hk）獲取詳細科目列表。
**9. 後備計劃**
鑑於 Band A 錄取率約 30.3%，在 Band A 或 B 中準備與興趣相符的後備選擇（如中大其他社會科學課程）。
- 將 JS4850 作為首選，其他選擇應基於預測分數保持 realistic。
